explication: Spree is an open-source commerce platform spanning a Rails commerce backend, REST APIs and typed clients, React admin and seller dashboards, and project tooling. A principal workflow is staff managing a store through the dashboard, whose API client communicates with the backend; storefronts and seller surfaces use the same platform for customer and marketplace workflows. The graph preserves documented commerce capabilities and the principal package boundaries. Source inspection was selective, so unsampled subsystem connections are included only where the README documents them.
